title: Learning User Representations to Improve Simulation Fidelity
abstract: arXiv:2610.22518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User simulators enable interactive training and evaluation of AI assistants at scale. Yet current simulators struggle to reproduce the diverse behaviors of real users, leading to assistants that generalize poorly to underrepresented users. We identify user representations as an underexplored bottleneck in user simulation. User representations are natural-language descriptions that condition simulators to reproduce a particular user's behavior. A representation's quality becomes apparent in hindsight, through the behavior it induces in a simulator. translated_title: 学习用户表示以提升模拟保真度
translated_abstract: 用户模拟器能够大规模地对AI助手进行交互式训练和评估。然而，当前的模拟器难以再现真实用户的多样化行为，导致助手对代表性不足的用户泛化能力较差。我们将用户表示确定为用户模拟中一个未被充分探索的瓶颈。用户表示是一种自然语言描述，用于作为模拟器的条件，使其再现特定用户的行为。表示的质量只有在事后通过其在模拟器中引发的行为才能显现。为了评估和优化用户表示，我们提出了一个对话重建任务：给定一段原始对话，先生成一个用户表示，将其作为模拟器的条件，模拟一段对话，然后通过比较原始对话与模拟对话中的用户行为来衡量保真度。这种比较还会产生事后反馈，用于识别表示中存在的不足。
tldr: 该论文将用户表示识别为用户模拟的关键瓶颈，提出通过对话重建任务与事后反馈来评估和优化自然语言形式的用户表示，从而提升用户模拟器复现真实用户行为的保真度。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies user representations as an underexplored bottleneck in user simulation, and proposes a conversation reconstruction task with hindsight feedback to evaluate and optimize natural-language user representations, thereby improving simulation fidelity.
